proposed.dnsOrIp: 72.60.36.182 (Hostinger VPS that currently serves Production site dalia-car.online) — NOT approved yet. Alternative: a dedicated Staging VPS.
proposed.whyTcp: Official ERM StarLink protocol is $payload*CS over TCP. Device P49/P50 are host+port. TLS is not in the protocol we implemented; enabling TLS would require device-side TLS that we must not configure now.
proposed.where: systemd unit fleetos-erm-listener on a Staging-approved host. Must not change nginx, dist, or Production site files.
proposed.restart: Restart=always in systemd. Not installed yet.
proposed.firewall: ufw allow 5055/tcp comment 'ERM StarLink Staging' — not applied.
proposed.unknownDevice: ingest returns unknown_device, ACK is not sent, gps_raw reason=unknown_device only.
proposed.secrets: FLEETOS_GPS_SERVICE_ROLE in EnvironmentFile mode 600. Frontend never sees it. Listener refuses Production ref qasomfndnjuixgjmjwcm.
proposed.rollback: systemctl stop fleetos-erm-listener; ufw delete allow 5055/tcp; bind remains 127.0.0.1 without FLEETOS_GPS_PUBLIC=1.

risk: Using the existing Hostinger VPS puts a public TCP service on the same machine as Production nginx. That needs explicit Owner approval. A dedicated Staging VPS is safer.
